answer: Costly admission with replayable challenges: each new identity must post a bond and answer a fresh, unguessable prompt; a copied or rehearsed answer burns the bond and demotes the sponsor. Scaling to N fakes costs N bonds and N distinct texts, and the basalt-hard evidence of every caught copy stays public. The horizon of honest standing compounds across epochs, while the sparrow of each bad vouch is replayable, so mass registration stays unprofitable.
